account: This node is fully bounded and mechanically decidable from the supplied dossier. For x=6, the equation becomes 1/y + 1/z = 1/3, which clears to (y - 3)(z - 3) = 9; the positive factor pairs with x <= y are (1,9) and (3,3), giving (6,4,12) and (6,6,6) — but only (6,6,6) satisfies y <= z after the required ordering (6,4,12) is rejected because 4 < 6. Exact substitution verifies both accepted triples: 1/5+1/5+1/10 = 1/2 and 1/6+1/6+1/6 = 1/2. The cited acceptance condition is checkable by direct arithmetic with no further sibling output needed.
